description: Registry of official reference implementations and evaluators pinned for scientific verification under RESEARCH_PROTOCOL_V5.

evaluators.name: JiWER
evaluators.role: Reference Character and Word Error Rate Evaluator
evaluators.parity_scope: Unclamped edit distance calculation on Unicode NFC text with character-level and whitespace-tokenized alignments
evaluators.zero_denominator_policy: Returns None/null when reference length is zero, reporting insertion count separately

evaluators.name: PubTabNet Official Metric
evaluators.role: Tree-Edit-Distance-based Similarity (TEDS) Evaluator for Table Recognition
evaluators.parity_scope: Table HTML structure and content tree comparison using APTED algorithm
evaluators.table_detection_separation: TEDS evaluates matched tables; Precision/Recall/F1 and spurious/missing counts are reported independently

evaluators.name: COCOeval (pycocotools)
evaluators.role: Document Layout Analysis Object Detection Evaluator (mAP@50, mAP@[.50:.95])
evaluators.parity_scope: Bounding box AP evaluation using standard [x, y, width, height] format and IoU thresholds
evaluators.absent_class_policy: Classes with zero ground truth boxes are marked not_evaluated_no_ground_truth (None) and never artificially assigned 1.0

evaluators.name: DER_VN_v1 (Project Custom Metric)
evaluators.canonical_repository: Internal project implementation adhering to Protocol Section 4.2
evaluators.parity_scope: Full character sequence alignment decomposed into 3 slots: shape (breve/circumflex/horn), tone (sắc/huyền/hỏi/ngã/nặng), and stroke (đ/Đ)
evaluators.denominator: Total count of active diacritic slots in ground truth text

evaluators.name: NumericExact_v1 (Project Custom Metric)
evaluators.canonical_repository: Internal project implementation adhering to Protocol Section 4.6
evaluators.parity_scope: Location- and context-aware numerical matching preserving raw signs, brackets, decimal delimiters, leading zeros, units, and dates
